name: 劉慧雯
objective:
本課主旨在設計課程，提供練習，俾使學生嫻熟各式的英語測驗，如全民英檢、托福測驗、TOEIC 測驗或類似性質的測驗，希冀能夠藉由本課程的修習，提升學生不斷的學習外國語的興致，並且，藉由通過考試取得證照，增加未來職場的競爭力。
This course is designed to familiarize the students with various kinds of language proficiency tests such as GEPT, TOEFL, TOEIC and many others to the same end. It is our hope that the students who finish taking the course will go on with their enthusiasm on studying foreign languages; besides, through the acquisition of the certificate when the students pass the tests, they are sure to enhance their capability in the increasingly competitive job markets.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week	Content
1	Orientation & Course Platform Introduction
2	Unit 1: Practice Test 1
3	Unit 1: Practice Test 1
4	Quiz 1 & Unit 2: Practice Test 2
5	Unit 2: Practice Test 2
6	Quiz 2 & Unit 3: Practice Test 3
7	Unit 3: Practice
8	Review & Quiz 3
9	Midterm Exam
10	Unit 4: Practice Test 4
11	Unit 4: Practice Test 4
12	Quiz 4 & Unit 5: Practice Test 5
13	Unit 5: Practice Test 5
14	Quiz 5 & Unit 6: Practice Test 6
15	Unit 6: Practice Test 6
16	Review & Quiz 6
17	Final Exam
18	Independent Online Learning: Practice Test 7 & Learning Reflection
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● 線上數位教材學習 (Coursera、edX、磨課師等)(Online digital learning (Coursera, edX, MOOCs, etc.))
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          【第 17 週】進行期末評量，評量範圍為本學期 Practice Tests 4–6 所學之重要字彙、片語、基礎文法及句型，以檢視學生之學習成效。課程時數 2 小時。

【第 18 週】進行線上自主學習，學生運用本學期所學之測驗準備與語言學習方式，自主完成 Practice Test 7 學習教材及學校線上平台測驗，並完成本學期學習反思。課程時數 2 小時。
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          4
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          【第 17 週】完成期末考試，以紙筆測驗檢視學生對 Practice Tests 4–6 重要字彙、片語、基礎文法及句型之理解與應用。
【第 18 週】完成 Practice Test 7 線上自主學習及平台測驗，繳交線上測驗成績或完成紀錄，並完成本學期學習反思，以檢視學生自主學習歷程及整體學習收穫。
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          【第 17 週】期末考試占總成績 25%。
【第 18 週】線上自主學習與學習反思占總成績 10%。
